name: DoveNetQ
summary: Brisbane ISP of the Uniting Church in Australia (national dialup, 71 POPs); rebranded ISPX ~2012, then Planet Ozi by 2018 (THE UNITING CHURCH IN AUSTRALIA PROPERTY TRUST (Q.), ABN 25 548 385 225).

events.details: National dialup, broadband, hosting. Earliest Wayback capture 12 Dec 1998 (dovenetq.net.au).
Acquired by ISPX — homepage last Feb 2012; rebranded ISPX, 302 from 2013.

refs.label: By Apr 2013 DoveNetQ redirected to ISPX, the rebranded successor.
Brand's own homepage survived only to Feb 2012.
